evals.expected_output: Reviews current changed code with one generalist review agent and reports only confirmed, reachable bugs relevant to the MVP or local demo.
assertions: Exactly one general-purpose review agent is launched
The working tree or current branch diff is used as the review target
Plans and QA reports are optional context rather than blocking gates
Only functional bugs with a realistic trigger and concrete impact are reported
Speculative hardening, architecture, style, and generic coverage findings are omitted
A clear MVP/demo verdict is provided

evals.expected_output: Fetches the external PR with gh, sends its diff to one generalist reviewer, and returns a concise bug review without posting it.
assertions: The PR is fetched using gh pr view and gh pr diff
Exactly one general-purpose review agent is launched
The review focuses on changed-code bugs with realistic reproduction paths
No GitHub comment is posted unless the user explicitly requested it
Findings include specific file references, triggers, and impacts

evals.prompt: check my work, is this ready for a local demo?
evals.expected_output: Performs a lightweight one-agent bug review and gives a direct ready-or-fix recommendation for the demo scope.
assertions: The skill activates from the natural-language request
Exactly one general-purpose review agent is launched
Deep security and production-readiness concerns are excluded unless concretely reachable
Only HIGH and MEDIUM confirmed bugs are reported
A clear PASS or NEEDS FIX verdict is provided
